تستحبي (form X)
# تَسْتَحِبِّي (tastaḥibbī) /tas.ta.ħib.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَبَّ (istaḥabba)
# تُسْتَحَبِّي (tustaḥabbī) /tus.ta.ħab.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَبَّ (istaḥabba)
